141    public function lastName($gender = null)
142    {
143        if ($gender === static::GENDER_MALE) {
144            return static::lastNameMale();
145        }
146
147        if ($gender === static::GENDER_FEMALE) {
148            return static::lastNameFemale();
149        }
150
151        return $this->generator->parse(static::randomElement(static::$lastNameFormat));
152    }
